cohort: 9 pregnancies with antenatally detected cystic hygroma
finding: Antenatal screening for cystic hygroma and postnatal treatment with intralesional bleomycin resulted in good outcomes for most cases, with a reduction in lesion size and minimal surgical intervention.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was planned elective C-section in 57% of cases while normal vaginal delivery attained in 43% of cases.
